nodes.label: Data & configuration safety
nodes.rationale: Never commit credentials, caches, databases or logs; check settings.json before using real data; route component writes through db.py with bound values and db.quote_identifier().

nodes.label: config.py frozen-aware APP_DIR and LIBRARY_ROOT
nodes.rationale: Every data file lives in APP_DIR (exe dir when frozen); LIBRARY_ROOT found by walking up to Footprints.pretty or a .kicad_dbl; config.py re-reads settings.json itself to stay import-cycle free.

nodes.label: All component writes via db.insert/update/delete/move_data_to_table
nodes.rationale: These set Created/Modified audit columns themselves, insert a Change_Log row in the same transaction and emit brensan.audit after commit; raw SQL loses the trail; update_data skips when nothing differs.

nodes.label: run_in_background worker + queue + root.after(100) pump
nodes.rationale: Workers run on a thread and must never touch widgets; results are delivered on the main thread by _pump_events draining a queue.Queue; ProductTreeWindow and ObsoleteProductsWindow share the pattern instead of update_idletasks loops.

nodes.label: build_main_ui mutates App (two-way coupling)
nodes.rationale: ui.widgets.build_main_ui assigns app.tree, form_frame, status_var, busy_buttons, progress_bar, cancel_button; create_combobox_styles must run first so named styles exist; any attribute it sets must not be re-created in App.

nodes.label: db.connection(commit=False) context manager
nodes.rationale: Always closes and rolls back on error; tests monkeypatch db.get_connection which connection() resolves at call time, so never sqlite3.connect(DB_FILE) directly.

nodes.label: All user-facing strings are English
nodes.rationale: External workbook headers and parsing aliases (Turkish purchasing headers, Part Number Request layout) are preserved; code comments may be mixed.

nodes.label: _normalize_key central matching convention
nodes.rationale: Lowercase, µ/μ -> u, drop °, strip non-alphanumerics; every column/alias/supplier-field match goes through it so 'Manufacturer Part Number', Manufacturer_Part_Number and manufacturerpartnumber resolve to one column; extend alias lists rather than adding ad-hoc header checks.
